0022600007.text: The Denver Nuggets open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, who are 1-0, second in the Northwest Division, and sixth in the West. In the 2025-26 season series, the Nuggets lost 1-3, but they won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, and Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City will be without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery).
